commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
90+4' PENALTY APPEAL after Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

90+3' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) outmuscles the defender near the penalty spot and get his head to a cross from Yeray Alvarez. The accuracy is lacking, however, and the ball spins well wide of the right post.
90+1' It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
90+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
88' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.
88' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

88' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

87' Julian Chicco (Leganes) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Unai Simon anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
87' Crossbar! Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
85' The resulting corner from Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) comes to nothing.

84' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
83' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Substitution. Mikel Vesga leaves the pitch and is replaced by Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Julian Chicco (Leganes) will replace Darko Brasanac.
82' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Miguel de la Fuente will be replaced by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes).
81' The corner kick from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

78' A through ball from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach Oihan Sancet as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Oihan Sancet could have got into a promising position.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) comes onto the pitch so that Dani Raba can be given a rest.
75' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
75' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
72' It is time for a substitution. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is on for Alex Berenguer.
72' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
72' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Hernandez signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Ath Bilbao.
71' The total number of attempts is 23:3. The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
69' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Inaki Williams, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
67' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
66' Dani Raba (Leganes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
63' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
62' What a great touch by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
62' The attendance is 47612.
61' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Alex Berenguer just over the bar.
61' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
61' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) replacing Mikel Jauregizar.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andoni Gorosabel trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).

60' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' The game is interrupted now, Yvan Neyou (Leganes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

56' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
56' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
56' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
55' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes a short free kick. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
54' Referee Alejandro Hernandez sees the trip by Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
52' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.

50' Yuri Berchiche sends a slide-rule pass into the feet of Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), who without a second thought fires a shot in on goal from mid-range which only goes just wide of the right post.
49' Dani Raba (Leganes) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

49' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
47' Chance! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Yuri Berchiche, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
46' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
46' Ernesto Valverde makes a half-time substitution. Yuri Berchiche comes on in place of Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
44' A pass from Dani Raba (Leganes) is intercepted by Unai Simon and the move breaks down.
43' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Marko Dmitrovic is equal to it.
43' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
41' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries to find Inaki Williams, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
37' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
37' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao). The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
34' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
33' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar.
32' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
32' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Hernandez signals. A free kick to Ath Bilbao.
28' Adria Altimira (Leganes) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
27' 8:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
25' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
24' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
23' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) plays a lovely through ball to Gorka Guruzeta, but he can't beat Marko Dmitrovic and loses the ball.
22' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
19' A clumsy foul by Yvan Neyou (Leganes) and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle.
17' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
16' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
14' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
13' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

12' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
11' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
8' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
7' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) sends a long ball forward to Juan Cruz, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
6' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Hernandez.
